//: Row counts used by the ECSqlWriteStatement vs bulk instance write comparison.
//rowCounts: Default tiers kept modest so the suite stays fast in CI.
//largeRowCounts: Opt-in tiers for the ~1M row scenario. Enable with BULK_WRITE_PERF_LARGE=1.
//batchSize: Rows handed to the native layer per bulk call. 0 means one single call for the whole set.
//batchSweep: Row count used by the batch-size sweep, and the batch sizes it tries. 0 means a single call for the whole set.
//repeats: Each sweep configuration is timed this many times and the best (minimum) time is reported, to suppress GC/scheduling noise.
